intake.title: Your Pre-Audit Brain Dump
intake.intro: Eight questions. Voice or type — your call. Don't overthink any of them — first instinct is usually the most useful answer. You can save and come back anytime.

questions.label: Tell me about your business in one paragraph.
questions.helper: What do you actually do, who do you serve, and how long have you been doing it? Skip the polished pitch — talk like you're telling a friend.
questions.voice_prompt: In one go, tell me what your business does, who it serves, and how long you've been at it.

questions.label: How do you actually make money right now?
questions.helper: Walk me through your offers, pricing, and roughly what % of revenue comes from each. Be honest — it can be one offer, three offers, or 'mostly one thing and some random side stuff.'
questions.voice_prompt: Talk me through how money actually comes in. What do you sell, what does it cost, and roughly what's the revenue split?

questions.label: Walk me through a typical work week.
questions.helper: What do your days look like? When are you on, when are you off? What's the rhythm of your work — client calls, content creation, admin? Where does your time actually go?
questions.voice_prompt: Walk me through a typical work week — what your days look like and where your time actually goes.

questions.label: What do you do over and over and over?
questions.helper: List the tasks you find yourself doing repeatedly — every client, every week, every project. Onboarding emails. Proposal docs. Social posts. Reporting. Invoicing. Anything that has a pattern. The more the merrier here.
questions.voice_prompt: List every repetitive task you can think of — anything you do over and over. The boring stuff. The 'I've done this 50 times' stuff. Don't filter.

questions.label: Where does your business get stuck or break down?
questions.helper: What are the bottlenecks? The things you avoid? The tasks that always run late? The handoffs that drop balls? The bits that drain you the most? Be specific — 'admin' is too vague; 'chasing invoices on the 15th of every month' is gold.
questions.voice_prompt: Where does your business get stuck or break down? What do you avoid, what runs late, what drains you?

questions.label: What tools are you using right now?
questions.helper: Everything. Email platform, CRM, accounting, calendar, project mgmt, social schedulers, AI tools, the random spreadsheet you can't let go of. Note any tools you're paying for but barely using.
questions.voice_prompt: List every tool you're using right now — email, CRM, accounting, project tools, AI, spreadsheets, everything. Including ones you're paying for but barely using.

questions.label: How are you currently using AI (if at all)?
questions.helper: What AI tools have you tried? What's worked, what hasn't? What are you curious about but haven't touched? Be honest if the answer is 'almost nothing' — that's a great starting point.
questions.voice_prompt: Honestly — how are you using AI right now? What have you tried, what's worked, what's still a mystery?

questions.label: If you could wave a wand and fix three things in your business by next month — what would they be?
questions.helper: No tools, no constraints, no 'realistic.' Just: what would make the biggest difference to your day-to-day if it was solved?
questions.voice_prompt: Wave a wand — what three things in your business would you fix by next month if you could? No constraints, no realistic. Just the wishlist.
